hints.title: Postfix Expression Tree Construction
hints.text: Iterate through postfix tokens assembling tree nodes from bottom to top.

hints.title: Operand and Operator Nodes
hints.text: When encountering an operand, push a numeric node; when encountering an operator, pop two children and attach them.

hints.title: Polymorphic or Recursive Evaluation
hints.text: Implement evaluate() on nodes by recursively evaluating left and right child nodes and applying the arithmetic operation.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: number of tokens in postfix expression
complexity.notes: Constructing tree visits each token once, and evaluating executes postorder traversal in linear time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: String replacements or non-tree re-evaluation misses object-oriented abstraction requirements.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Explicit binary expression tree captures operation precedence with minimal stack overhead.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Clean object-oriented node hierarchy implementing evaluate() method.

solutions.approach: Postfix Expression Stack with Recursive Evaluate
